description.value:
A race of floating lamb-like humanoids who specialize in magery, known for their gentle spirit and pastoral charm.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Lambkins gain +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Constitution.
  • Type: Lambkins are humanoids with the lambkin subtype.
  • Size: Lambkins are Small creatures.
  • Base Speed: Lambkins have a base speed of 20 feet on land, floating a couple of feet off the ground.
  • Languages: Lambkins begin play speaking Common and Lambkin. Lambkins with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Magic Resistant: Lambkins gain spell resistance equal to 6 + their character level.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Magic Expert: Lambkins gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (Arcana) and Spellcraft checks.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Auto-Float: Lambkins are always considered to have the Float status.
  • Magic Aptitude: Lambkins gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance and a +2 racial bonus on dispel checks.
  • Magick Focus: Lambkins gain a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks made to cast spells defensively.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Lambkins can see twice as far as humes in dim light.
